full_judgment: 13. In Civil Appeal No. 280 of 2001, Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate on Record appeared for the respondents Nos. 4-5 and 14, and Mr. Mozibur Rahman, learned Advocate on Record appeared for the respondents Nos. 6, 8-12 and 15.
